title: Erdős–Kac theorem
abstract: A complete formalisation, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, of the Erdős–Kac theorem: the number of distinct prime factors ω(n), centred by log log N and scaled by sqrt(log log N), satisfies a central limit theorem on {1, …, N}. The proof goes through Mertens' second theorem and a truncated sieve whose moments are compared with an independent-prime model. Moment comparison is carried over to characteristic functions by a Taylor truncation of exp(iτs), whose remainder is controlled by a uniform even-moment bound; the model characteristic function converges to the Gaussian, and Lévy's continuity theorem finishes.
